title: Ye Sons of Earth, Arise
description: Ye Sons of Earth, Arise in Tonic Solfa to BOYLSTON, doh is C: the solfa with the words, staff notation, 3 verses and a piano.
about: These words were printed without an author's name in Hymns for Christian Devotion, compiled by John G. Adams and Edwin H. Chapin (Boston, 1846), as hymn 278 of its twenty-second edition (1853), “Coming to Christ”, where the book credits them to Pratt's Collection.
The book printed the words without tunes, marked Short Metre (6.6.8.6), to be sung to any tune of that metre. This page sets them to BOYLSTON; any other Short Metre tune fits them as well.
underlay: Ye sons of earth, a-rise, Ye crea-tures of a day; Re-deem the time be bold be wise, And cast your bonds a-way.

lines: Redeem the time — be bold — be wise,
O, bid us turn and live.

licence: Public domain: anonymous words in print by 1853.
credits: Words anonymous, public domain, as printed in Hymns for Christian Devotion (1853); set to BOYLSTON by NoteFusion, as words-only hymn books were sung.
